latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Scarcity Framing Strategist.

- Provides psychological frameworks to design or audit scarcity messaging for offers and campaigns.
- Supports both APPLICATION (creating effective scarcity) and DEFENSE (recognizing/managing scarcity tactics) modes.
- Guides users through classification of scarcity type (limited number, deadline, exclusivity) and origin for ethical and credible framing.
- Covers ethical considerations to prevent misuse or manipulation.
- Works with promotional copy, pricing pages, campaign briefs, or user descriptions across multiple contexts.
